founder.title: Why I built SoulType
founder.p1: I've spent years fascinated by cognitive psychology and personality frameworks like MBTI. But every time I took a test online, the outcome was the same: 4 letters on a screen, a generic 20-page PDF I never opened again, and zero actionable help when facing daily self-doubt, overthinking, or big life decisions.
founder.p2: I created SoulType to bridge that gap: a safe, private space designed to truly understand how your brain processes the world. A companion that remembers your breakthroughs, deconstructs your blind spots, and empowers you to grow at your own pace.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is my personal data and journal private?
faq.a1: Absolutely. Your inner journal and conversations are strictly confidential. We do not sell your data or use it to train public AI models. Your sanctuary is yours alone.
faq.q2: How is this different from just talking to ChatGPT?
faq.a2: SoulType uses a highly specialized psychological framework. Instead of a generic assistant, you get a dedicated coach mapped to your specific cognitive functions, featuring long-term memory and a dynamic calibration system.
faq.q3: Do I need to know my MBTI type before starting?
faq.a3: Not at all. The journey begins with a deep cognitive assessment that will accurately determine your archetype before generating your AI Soul Coach.
faq.q4: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a4: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any moment with a single click in your settings. You will retain your premium benefits until the end of your billing cycle.
